The meta description describes it as a dedicated platform for research at the confluence of machine learning and cybernetics. The visible content lists its electronic ISSN (1868-808X) and print ISSN (1868-8071). It also lists the abstracting and indexing services that cover the journal, including SCIE, Scopus, EI Compendex, Google Scholar, INSPEC, DBLP and ProQuest.
